common.label: SYNTHETIC — not evidence about learners or experts

default.model: p_i ~ Beta(a, b), mean 0.3; CV 0.21 low, 0.60 high, 0.97 extreme (a < 1: infinite density at p = 0, a sensitivity case). With probability rho an item's k text captures copy one shared Bernoulli(p_i) draw, else they are independent, so the within-item correlation is rho. Never-written items: catchability 0 on every text occasion. Gold catches every item independently with probability gold_p; matching is exact.

ds4.model: logit p_i ~ Normal(mu, sigma) with mu set so E[p] = mean_p; two_class matches that mean and SD with weight 0.25 on the high class. Text captures X_ij = 1{sqrt(rho) W_i + sqrt(1-rho) E_ij < Phi^-1(p_i)}: a Gaussian copula, exchangeable across text occasions, conditional on p_i. Gold catches written items with g_W and never-written with min(1, ratio * g_W). A gold item that text caught fails to match with probability false_non_match and is then counted as gold-uncaught; the corpus-presence audit (DS4 §3.3) is exact. Text, gold and match/noise use separate random streams.
